articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) Based Cloud Computing System for an Industrial Company
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) is a device switching get up automatically between the power source main source and a certain secondary source. When a failure in the primary power system automatic transfer switch change to a secondary power source. Automatic Transfer Switch can also operate more long-term standby power systems, such as local diesel generators to power electrical devices until interested power is restored. Cloud computing has the potential to greatly improve automation in industrial monitoring by providing access to scalable computing resources and data storage. With cloud computing industrial automation systems can process and analyze large amounts of data in real-time enabling better decision-making. Using cloud computing for automation can also help reduce costs as it eliminates the need for expensive on-premises hardware and allows for a pay-as-you-go model. The using of cloud computing in industrial automation can lead to increased efficiency, and productivity. In this study, an ATS was designed and implemented through cloud computing using the AutoCAD program and microcontroller (ESP-wroom-32) element in order to be provide higher speed in controlling the switching of power sources for long distances, and to providing data analysis and making important decisions. In industrial stations, the process of controlling the circuit breakers of transformers and generators is done manually. Therefore, this system was designed and implemented to provide ease of control of these circuit breakers through the cloud, as well as reduce maintenance costs and protect operators from the danger of direct switching in circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Lightweight Cryptography Concepts and Algorithms: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Evolutionary technologies have been raised under the umbrella of the Internet, such as Cloud computing, The Internet of Things (IoT), and The Internet of Everything (IoE). All these technologies are extensively data exchange channels, while they are not saving channels. Security plays a vital role; thus, the data must not be easily reached by any type or method of attack. The new trends in data protection are looking for easy-to-use, low-consumption, and high-performance methods. Therefore, Lightweight cryptography algorithms appeared strongly in the protection field; since this type of cipher has the flexibility to be used in all the sharing and using of data channels that have different characteristics and resources. This paper applies a light spot-on various encryption lightweight study. Where the paper presents analyzing the study of common symmetric lightweight algorithms implemented in many recent fields and shows the strength point of each of these algorithms.

articleTitle: Proposed Smart Water Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Human activities, such as farming, heavy industries, energy generation and mining, significantly demand water resources necessary for life. With the population and water demand increasing, water must be efficiently managed to meet human needs with sufficient supply to protect our ecosystems. Reduced aquifer levels worldwide render human civilization vulnerable to escalating climate change. This paper proposes a priority-based embedded smart water management system based on FreeRTOS technology to address a unique problem where existing water supply systems are inefficiently managed due to the absence of a need-based allocation methodology. Sustainability can be achieved by maintaining a real-time balance of supply and demand to disperse the limited water supply. With FreeRTOS backbone, the proposed system can be fully integrated into an AI-based infrastructure to manage water supply with minimum human intervention efficiently. This research demonstrated that a priority-based real-time water resource distribution system could contribute up to 40% of water management improvement for buildings, farms, and cities.

articleTitle: Using Differential Transform Method for Solving COVID-19 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: This paper aims to use the differential transform method (DTM) to find an approximate solution for a fractional differential system of (COVID-19) consisting of five equations in disease-sensitive S(t), exposed individuals E(t), infected patients I(t), recovered patients R(t) and death F(t) which Zahraa was solved it by Sumudu Adomian decomposition method and Fractional linear multi-step method. The approximate solution by DTM is in series form. Graphs are given to show the accuracy of the method. The approximate solution is evaluated by the differential transform method and this solution is in a series form. For each of the three values of the fractional order derivatives <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathfrak{c}x=0.6, \alpha=0.8$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha=0.9$</tex> we evaluate three approximate solutions for disease-sensitive S(t), exposed individuals E(t), infected patients I(t), recovered patients R(t) and death F(t), three graphs are given for S(t),E(t)&I(t) for the values of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha=0.6, \alpha=0.8$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha=0.9$</tex> to show the accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: Losses Estimation of Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: This paper advances the losses analysis for 550W, 4-phase, 8/6 poles Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM). In this respect, the motor model is simulated and analyzed based on three software: RMXprt, Maxwell2D, and Matlab/Simulink, where the motor model by Maxwell2D (which is finite element analysis software) is created basically by RMXprt (which is analytical software), and some of the input data for building Matlab/Simulink motor model are taking from RMXprt and Maxwell2D. Because the rotor is a salient pole that causes losses in the motor when it's running which reduces the motor's useful life so, very important to compute SRM losses quickly and accurately. The obtained results such as efficiency, core loss, copper loss, diode loss, transistor loss, and mechanical loss. Finally, for more accuracy, the simulation results like efficiency and total losses were compared in three software RMXprt, Maxwell2D, and Matlab/Simulink with an accepted error rate.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Detection Using Fusion-Based Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has been one of the most challenging crises attacking the world in the last three years. Many systems have been introduced in the field of COVID-19 detection. In this research, deep learning models for the detection of COVID-19 with a probability of the presence of COVID-19 are proposed. The COVID-19 dataset is split into 70% training and 30% testing using the holdout method. For the deep learning model, the CT images are fed into the model without feature extraction, and three different deep learning DL models (convolutional neural networks (CNN), GoogleNet, and residual nets (ResNet50)) are trained and evaluated. The three deep learning models are fused to obtain high accuracy, and get better performance. The trained models are evaluated using accuracy, precision and recall evaluation metrics. The experiments show that the best model is the deep-based fusion model by which the system achieved 96.4%, 96.2%, and 96.2% for accuracy, precision, and recall, respectively. Comparing our study with the related work proves the powerful and high performance of the proposed methodologies.

articleTitle: The Zero-Knowledge Proof Technique: Limitations and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Zero-knowledge proof is one of the techniques implemented in a variety of data security applications. ZKP is a security procedure between two parties, one as the prover and the other as the verifier. The prover and the verifier exchange information without allowing any kind of sensitive information to leak. In this paper, we mention the challenges and limitations that face the zero-knowledge technique when utilized in authentication and privacy protection processes in different environments. We help to produce improvements to the most common zero-knowledge protocol to show many factors that would have greatly contributed to the success of the authentication process.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Training Educational Board for Electromagnetic Control Experiments
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The paper deals with designing and implementing an open panel collecting essential pieces in the electromagnetic control field through which the trainee can perform a different set of practical experiments. Using these pieces simply without destroying any part of them because they are designed to bear all the mistakes made by the trainee with intent or without intent and with very high durability; it has adequate protection to avoid errors during the experiments. One of the most critical problems facing teachers and trainers is the delivery of practical information to recipients, despite the existence of modern technology in assisting them. However, ensuring maximum utilization and eliminating individual differences has not been reached to a large degree. The trainee also suffers in the operation of all of their intellectual and motor skills to ensure the maximum benefit of receiving the correct information and adjusting the scientific and engineering skills, so this problem has become shared between the trainer and the trainee; there are some programs and applications used to implement computer-based practical experiences such as Simulink and excellent results obtained, the designed board characterized by the purely functional work. A group of trainees used the board and were delighted because of the simplicity of using the board work and illustration for the concept. A questionnaire of 40 trainees sample supported the paper.

articleTitle: On Permutation Commutative Q-Algebras with Their Ideals
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Some of the new algebraic topics investigated in this paper, like permutation commutative Q-algebra, permutation commutative G-part., permutation commutative p-radical., permutation commutative <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{p}$</tex> -semisimple and permutation commutative Q-ideal are given and studied. We show that if the associative law is held for any permutation commutative Q-algebra <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\boldsymbol{X},\#,\boldsymbol{T})$</tex>., then <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$X$</tex> is a group under the operation “<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\#\prime\prime$</tex>. Also, the left cancellation law holds in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$G(X)$</tex>., where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{G}(\boldsymbol{X})$</tex> is the permutation commutative G-part of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{X}$</tex>. Additionally, the homomorphism, kernel, and image of permutation commutative Q-algebras and permutation commutative implicative Q-ideals were outlined with particular outcomes linked to the new concepts that we developed and tested.

articleTitle: An Interactive and Flexible Widget-Based Whiteboard Platform for E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: E-learning involves numerous virtual courses offered by primary universities or schools. Traditional courses prepared in a brick-and-mortar school facility are compared with online learning or virtual programs delivered through the internet. Existing works on whiteboard-based E-learning software have shown some limitations in terms of response time and high complexity. Therefore, in this paper, we proposed an interactive and flexible widget-based whiteboard platform to improve the performance of E-learning. Technically, we employed advanced software and programming languages to implement the proposed platform, such as C#, Dot Net Framework, Oxy-Plot, HelixToolKit, and MathPraser. The proposed platform is self-contained interactive modules. These modules can be easily searched and downloaded to the whiteboard program. A widget can be used to interactively and visually represent some concept, idea, or process. The experiments on real classroom cases verify the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed work. This improvement supports different e-learning scenarios, especially a better teacher/student experience.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Detection of CT Chest Images with Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Hundreds of thousands of people died as a result of the covid-19 sickness when it initially spread globally in 2019. Medical personnel is busier than ever as a result of this illness. Using machine learning and creating computer-aided diagnostic tools will help to some extent by reducing this pressure. The speedy elimination of this illness can be aided by any scientific investigation of it. In order, to extract Visual Geometry Group (VGG16) features, we used the publicly accessible Covid-19 dataset from the Kaggle website. Decision trees (DT), Random forest (RF), K-Nearest neighbor (KNN), eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and support vector machine (SVM) were some of the machine learning classification algorithms used to assess our work. In terms of classification accuracy, the Support vector machine(SVM)algorithm excels at 98% accuracy, and it also achieves impressively rapid results.

articleTitle: Botnet Creation, Life Cycle, Infrastructure, and Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Among various network attacks, the most dangerous threats are those that are botnet-Ied. A botnet is an infected computer network that can carry out extensive illegal activity. These attacks are one of the main risks to cyber security. The idea of botnets spreading throughout the entire worldwide network of computers is introduced by this new attack pattern. Given the numerous illicit acts, high reported infection rates, and powerful comeback, Botnet is one of the main risks to cyber security. this paper offers an essential overview of botnets, their structure, lifecycle, and types, and several tools and methods have been introduced to track botnet detection. This paper reviews various techniques for detecting botnets in the last years and provided what are the newly used techniques that give high accuracy in detecting botnets in IoT devices. And as shown in multiple previous papers that the best accuracy is achieved by utilizing the CNN model, which can reach 99.992 % in botnet detection.

articleTitle: Improvement of Face Recognition Rate under Varying Illumination by Using Normalized Eigenface
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: It began to rely a lot on face detection and recognition techniques and use them in various applications in our daily lives, especially in recent years, which motivated companies and researchers to develop this technology and reduce its errors. Despite that, the results of these techniques are still affected by many factors, most notably the age, accuracy, and difference in illumination or the low lightness of the images. For this reason, we will create a system that reduces the effect of low and different illumination of the image and increases its recognition accuracy, by using the Eigenface algorithm (or PCA) with normalization to reduce errors brought on by background and lighting, also Histogram Equalization is used to enhance low-light images to achieving high recognition accuracy for low-light images and images that contains shadows. Finally, the experimental results on the Yale B, Extended Yale B and AR databases indicate that the proposed method is considering the best method to use in good and poor lighting cases, as it achieved the highest and most accurate results when used in all the databases. This system appears to be a successful way to solve some facial recognition problems and increases the rate and accuracy of recognition. The results show that the efficiency of the proposed work is enhanced by 13.586-222.967% compared with the Eigenface method and 0.389-10.294% compared with Normalize Eigenface method.

articleTitle: Proposed Security Evaluation of Post-Quantum Cryptography Based on Soft Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Developing security evaluation algorithms is one of computer networks' most significant difficulties today. This is a result of clients increasingly exchanging data (users). As a result, it has lately come to light that cryptography systems' security level evaluation component is crucial. In this study, a hybrid ANFIS facility combining Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Fuzzy Logic approaches is used in the editor of MATLAB (2021a). The encryption technique (Lattice-Based Crypto) has been designed and programmed using a simulation based on its original algorithm. The Lattice-Based Crypto technique is therefore used to acquire data values for the following parameters (message length, execution time, length of key, and cipher message entropy). They executed specialized software programs that selected values as the training sample number. The ANFIS editor was opened, the training data was loaded, the key ANFIS parameters were identified, and the training data was trained using the lowest error tolerance. The best membership function is empirically found to be assigned for the ‘Trimf’ for the Lattice-Based Cryptography. where it has achieved the best performance in the training phase. (Trimf=0.35355, Trapmf=0.41601, Gbellmf=0.48539, Gaussmf=0.43792, Gauss2mf=0.47423, Pimf=0.41197, Dsigmf=0.40179, Psigmf=0.6574).

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Data Computing Scenario Forecasting System Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: One of the main drawbacks of using ML and DL-based optimization techniques is that a massive amount of historical data is needed for the algorithms to converge to quasi-optimal solutions. In the DCs' scope, it is difficult, expensive, and sometimes even dangerous to gather data from all kinds of real situations, as the equipment's physical integrity may be at risk. Thus, the generation of realistic synthetic data in computing environments is crucial to enabling these optimization technologies. The goal of this paper is to create an automated system that produces near-term forecasts of globally important economic / financial time series. The system will create features from a wide variety of data sources and create forecasts using an ensemble of time series models. We will exploit distributed computing and storage technologies to build a system that is always on, evaluating new potential features and constantly updating the deployed forecasting model. We will begin with the daily spot price of crude oil but hope to expand to other important series. This paper proposes to solve these challenges by generating synthetic data and forecasting possible realistic scenarios in a real cloud-based DC environment. For this purpose, we will use a technique that has given extraordinary results in recent years: generative adversarial networks (GAN). These generative algorithms based on artificial neural networks have been commonly used to create realistic synthetic multimedia data (mainly images and videos). Some proposals in the state of the art use GAN to generate synthetic time-series data. However, this research has significant limitations, such as the limitation of handling multi-variable and categorical data in the generation of scenarios.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for the Recognition of Skin Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The health industry has kept growing over the years with breakthroughs. However, in skin disease recognition such as cancer, there is still a battle to improve how recognition is implemented to get the desired result. The paper focuses on skin cancer recognition using deep learning. In addition, a cloud-based model-based architecture that uses deep learning algorithms in its core applications to create models that help predict skin cancer with improved accuracy is considered. System analysis and specification are also done in conjunction with a description of procedures and requirements. Implementation and testing are also done and finalized with the conclusion and future work. The main outcomes of the results and conclusion will be drawn from the implementation and testing that are carried out on the data. In addition to the fact that the implications of the findings would become valuable and further used as a benchmark for future research work in the research domain.

articleTitle: Epilepsy Database Collection Implementing Smartphone Inertial Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent seizures and these seizures require ongoing monitoring. Data collection is a crucial first step to improve our understanding of this condition. Implementing smartphone inertial sensors is a new approach to epilepsy data collection that involves using the accelerometer and gyroscope sensors in a smartphone to record physical movements during a seizure episode. The aim of data collection is to gain a deeper insight into the characteristic patterns of seizures and to improve its management. Because there was not any available dataset for epilepsy detection and all the researchers in the previous studies used locally produced datasets so, an Android application was developed that can collect raw data from motion sensors (accelerometer and gyroscope) and experiments were conducted to determine the best sample rate for epilepsy cases. In this paper, we presented an application for gathering a dataset of sensor data from 30 people 15 male and 15 females between the age of 18-45, and each participant were asked to perform 9 activities. The sampling rate used in collecting data has been investigated and analyzed using Fast Fourier Transform technique resulting a suitable sampling rate (50 samples/second) for capturing motion sensor data. The results show that smartphones can accurately record physical movements during seizures and can efficiently be utilized to collect a sizable and diverse dataset for enhancing seizure detection algorithms.

articleTitle: A New Simple 6D Hyperchaotic System with Higher Largest Lyapunov Exponent and Kaplan-York Dimension and its Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to propose a method for linearly regulating a 3D chaotic Lü system to a simple 6D system using state feedback and coupling controllers. The proposed system has four positive Lyapunov exponents and line equilibrium points, classifying it as a hidden attractor. Compared to other traditional systems, this system has a higher largest exponent and dimension Lyapunov but is relatively simple, only consisting of ten terms. The paper investigates the dynamical features of the system, including equilibria points, stability, dissipative, conservative, multistability, and synchronization. In the end, the system was constructed as an analog electronic circuit and then simulated using an oscilloscope device. The simulation validated that there was a precise and effective correspondence between the MATLAB 2021 and Multisim 14.2 software.

articleTitle: A Review of An Emerging Cyber Kill Chain Threat Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: This paper proposed a review of how Industrial Control Systems (ICS) have facilitated the evolution of today's legacy machines from purely mechanical fabrications to electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic, respectively. The increasing machine connectivity and digitalization are leading to an increase in cybersecurity issues affecting ICS as these systems are updated to conform to the new Industry 4.0, IoT, and cloud computing infrastructure to achieve specific industrial goals. For this case study, we explore the threat posed by Ransomware-as-a-Service (RAAS) and the business model propagated by the criminal organization DarkSide for using RAAS to launch a cyberattack against the ICS of the Colonial Oil and Gas Company. The current approach of implementing a response after a cyber-attack prompted shifting to in-progress response mechanisms as cyber-attacks become more complex and time-consuming. Based on prior work by Lockheed Martin and Varonis, a new and improved Cyber Kill Chain Framework is proposed. This framework details the eight steps of a cyberattack: surveillance, intrusion, exploitation, privilege escalation, lateral movement, obfuscation/anti-forensics, denial of service, and exfiltration. The Detect-Deny-Disrupt mitigation actions may need to be continuously updated to better the framework and ICS cyber-attack mitigation efforts.

articleTitle: Network Selection based on Multiple Techniques for Heterogeneous Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: In recent years, selecting the best networks for users has now become critical for heterogeneous wireless networks (HWN). Using multiple attribute decision-making (MADM) can provide users with satisfactory service in network selection and also keep service quality requirements. In this paper, we handled TOPSIS, GRA, and VIKOR methods with a voting system for network selection. The mathematical results were calculated in MATLAB for the proposed technique and compared with the results of the aforementioned methods in terms of the handover. The comparison results showed that the proposed technique achieved lower handover than the other methods where the handover of the proposed technique, GRA, TOPSIS., and VIKOR are 17, 19, 47, and 65, respectively.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Multi-Band Quad-Port MIMO Antenna for the 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new dual-configuration antenna designed to meet the demands of 5G applications. This antenna is based on a square shape, with multiband and various frequencies, and multiple slots with dimensions of 37.4mm x 39.4mm x 1.6mm. It has a low reflection coefficient <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{S} 11 \leq-15 ~\text{dB})$</tex>, making it suitable for multi-band applications. The square shape was transformed into a four-port MIMO antenna, which provides good performance for 5G applications with adequate bandwidth for increased data rates and reduced antenna size. The MIMO antenna was implemented on the Roger RT5880 dielectric with a size of 80mm x 80mm x 1.6mm. It offers fewer return losses, high efficiency, and high radiation pattern coverage, covering the bands of 2.57 GHz, 2.89 GHz, 3.27 GHz, 3.92 GHz, 5.05 GHz, 5.53 GHz, and 6.09 GHz. The antenna design was developed using the CST software 2021, and the prototypes were measured by a Vector Network Analyzer (VNA). Both the simulation results and the measurement results have been met.

articleTitle: New Tax System based on Lightweight Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Tax records are a very important aspect for every citizen each time a resident needs to deal with financial paperwork or obtain a Tax clearance, it takes a long time due to the official letters exchanged between Authorized governmental agencies, resulting in a waste of time. And vulnerable to fraud or subject to lose, theft, or damage of tax records paper. This led to using an electronic tax record system which saves time and reduces costs these systems are susceptible to various known attacks, including denial of service, modification, and hijacking, and to secure these systems, non-fungible token (NFT) concepts utilizing the blockchain are employed which is known as secure and immutable with decentralization characteristics which provide multiple copies of the tax records and eliminate the need for official letters between Authorized governmental agencies for verification of past Tax clearance. This paper proposes an electronic Tax records system based on non-fungible tokens and a customized lightweight blockchain technology that utilizes a consensus algorithm called proof of secret sharing (PoSS) for authenticating nodes and verifying added blocks, this system is evaluated using standard blockchain with proof of work consensus algorithm evaluation parameters to demonstrate its lightweight nature, security, and reduced computational resource requirements.

articleTitle: Autism Classification Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: We are currently seeing a rapid spread of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), so when studying autis0m behaviors, researchers note that this study requires substantial costs and time to characterize autism. Through the use of machine learning techniques, autism can be detected early. There are studies using machine learning techniques, but they have not provided any conclusion in determining the characteristics of autism due to the different ages of people. This study aims is to predict autism in any age group (children, adolescents, adults), using a classification system based on machine learning techniques (random forest (RF), decision tree (CART), Naive Bayes (NB), and Support Vector Machine (SVM). The results from algorithms (CART, SVM, NB, and RF) are evaluated using several metrics (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 Score) based on the AQ dataset- 10. The model used showed advanced results in evaluating the accuracy of the types of datasets. The results provide superior performance for ASD classification. Random Forest and Support Vector Machine accuracy have been improved between (98% and 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) with features selected by correlation technology and K fold split data.

articleTitle: An Overview for Channel Equalization Techniques in Filter Bank
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Filter Bank Multi-Carrier Offset-QAM (FBMC OQAM) is one of the hottest topics of research in 5G multicarrier methodologies. As a result of its high spectral efficiency, too- low sidelobe leakage, zero cyclic prefix (CP), and multiphase filter design, the receiver's channel equalization is the most important task toward achieving a high data rate and reliable wireless communication. However, different types of impairments, such as fading, Doppler shifts, and Inter Symbol Interference (ISI), are inflicted on the transmitted data symbols as they travel through the wireless channel, lowering the quality of the network as a whole. Numerous channel equalization algorithms have been proposed for use in communication systems to help alleviate the negative effects of the channel. In this paper, we provide a survey of equalization methods used by the receiver of a wireless FBMC OQAM communication system. Every approach's central idea, architecture, and operation are detailed.

articleTitle: Utilizing a High-Sensitive and Secure Communication System for Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Data transmission via communication is critical for any system, especially when the transmitted data is sensitive or important. It needs to be safe during movement between system components. Several studies and research projects have been conducted to solve this problem. In this paper, an optoelectronic feedback-based, highly sensitive chaotic communication system for secure communication is developed. The chaotic signal is produced by a semiconductor laser and used as a carrier of data. The 10-Gb / s signal was encrypted and sent through free space optical (FSO) and optical fiber links. The proposed data transmission technique was evaluated via computer simulation using Berkeley Madonna and Optisystem software. The encrypted signal was successfully received and decrypted at 13 km and 105 km for FSO and optical fiber, respectively. The Q-factor of these signals was 5.796 and 5.67, while the BER was 3.37 e-9 and 6.33 e-9, respectively. The proposed system showed high sensitivity to feedback strength and security, which were achieved easily and at a lower cost in comparison to similar techniques. The system is suitable for secure applications such as IoT and IoNT.

articleTitle: Recurrent Deep Learning to Predict Personality Types from Social Media Posts
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The analysis of personality behavior has become important in many applications such as educational hypermedia systems, psychotherapy, and business recommendation systems. With the development of social media platforms (SMPs), people can express their feelings and opinions through their personal posts, comments and/or tweets. This study aims to analyze texts on SMPs to identify users' personalities according to the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) model. It also sought to enhance prediction accuracy and compare the findings with various deep learning techniques and previous literature. This study analyzes personality through a dataset that includes 8667 participants. Two deep learning techniques are implemented namely, long short-term memory (LSTM) and convolutional neural network (CNN). Unlike earlier literature, this research helps improve the prediction accuracy of users' personalities by building a multi-layer deep learning network and integrating the random search optimization approach. The results suggest that LSTM with the application of random search optimization outperformed previous findings. The average prediction accuracy of the four dimensions namely, Introversion-Extroversion (IE), Feeling-Thinking (FT), Intuition-Sensing (NS), and Judging-Perceiving (JP) is 85.02%.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Monitoring System Based on IoT: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The price of renewable energy equipment decreases worldwide as technology advances, promoting the widespread deployment of solar photovoltaic systems. When implementing cutting-edge technology, the Internet of Things (IoT) is in the driver's seat, making everything go more quickly and efficiently. As monitoring is crucial for performance evaluation and controlling panels to function in a very excellent condition, this review's overarching goal is to encourage the monitoring of all solar photovoltaic solar arrays to keep everyone informed of their present status. Using IoT-based technology to keep an eye on a solar photovoltaic plant would significantly improve its performance, monitoring, and upkeep. This will aid in power generation by automatically positioning the equipment to induce maximum sunlight, allowing for easier preventative maintenance, historical analysis of the plant, and real-time observation. Suppose the sun's rays begin to weaken. In that case, solar panels will rotate to face in a different direction, maximizing the amount of sunlight they absorb and maximizing the efficiency with which they convert solar energy into usable form.

Author Keywords: fault detection of a PV system

articleTitle: A Review of LiFi Technology: Principles and Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Recently, there has been a significant increase in transmitted data as a result of the growth of the use of the Internet of Things (IoT) in all aspects of life. This growth has increased the demand for wireless bandwidth exponentially. This exponential demand cannot be met by the current radio frequency (RF) because of its limited spectrum. However, Light Fidelity (LiFi) technology is a wireless optical communication technology that is characterized by its very wide spectrum with maintaining confidentiality and reliability. Therefore, the research interest regarding wireless optical communication for indoor and outdoor environments has increased in recent years. This paper reviews the technology of the LiFi and presents the concepts in several aspects. These aspects include LiFi working principle and applications of LiFi. It also provides visualizations of practical uses of LiFi in the IoT and channel models. Other related research paths have been illustrated such as multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO), modulation techniques, environment, LiFi challenges, front-end equipment, and hybrid systems. The current review presents enough coverage on the advancing edge of LiFi technology to help illustrate a clear technical roadmap for the LiFi community.

articleTitle: Building a Cloud-Based, IoT - Based Thalassemia Management System E-Health System
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: A thalassemia is a group of inherited blood disorders characterized by abnormal hemoglobin production. It is a significant public health issue, with an estimated prevalence of 1.9% in the global population. Cloud computing has the potential to significantly improve the management and treatment of thalassemia. One way in which cloud computing can benefit thalassemia management is through the use of electronic medical records (EMRs). EMRs allow for the storage and sharing of patient information, including diagnostic results, treatment plans, and medication lists. By using cloud-based EMRs, healthcare providers can access and update patient information in real-time, improving coordination and communication among members of the care team. In this article, a private system is designed to monitor the situation of the thalassemia patients by using Matlab to design a graphical user interface for laboratory information in order to obtain patient data automatically without the need for the intervention of the medical team and to send this data to the Thalassemia Treatment Center so that the medical team can deal with cases of many patients, where patients' data can be updated automatically through the interface in the laboratory.

articleTitle: Detection of DDoS Attacks in Software-Defined Networks Based on Majority Voting-Average for Feature Selection and Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Software Defined Networking (SDN) is a new paradigm, which recently evolved to overcome the shortcomings of conventional networks. However, due to SDN's features and architectural design, it is vulnerable to a variety of dangerous attacks. DDoS attacks are regarded as the main devastating cyber-attacks that make the controller inaccessible to its valid users. Existing techniques exploit ML for detecting DDoS attacks in the SDN environment, utilizing standard datasets which include attacks that are distinct from those appearing in the traditional network. These techniques have multiple weaknesses; for instance, they are greatly influenced by the dimension of the dataset and the goodness of attributes (features), as duplicate and irrelevant attributes can significantly reduce performance. Combining feature selection (FS) with effective classifiers in the attack detection field can solve such problems. FS finds the significant features, which reduce the size of the dataset, the time required to build and test the classifier, and the complexity of interpreting network data traffic, thereby enhancing overall detection performance. In this work, majority voting and average techniques are proposed for feature selection (FS) to train seven machine learning classifiers. In the first step, the results of three different FS approaches are combined based on majority voting (or opinion); then, owing to these approaches, each feature has three weights; an average technique has been utilized to assign one weight to each feature and attain the best set of features. The classifiers utilized in this work are Support Vector Machine (SVM), eXtreme gradient boosting (XGBoost), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Decision Tree (DT), Naïve Bayes (NB), Random Forest (RF), and KNN that have been assessed utilizing the newly realistic dataset InSDN_2020, which includes a variety of DDoS attacks and fills the gaps in existing available datasets. The experimental outcomes indicated that all the proposed classifiers with the best set of 12 picked features achieved considerable improvements in terms of accuracy, precision, recall (sensitivity), and F1-Score. In addition to False Positive Rate (FPR), training and testing times are reduced. Furthermore, the Random Forest classifier with the best set of 12 selected features can reach (99.85% accuracy, 99.84℅ precision, 99.85% recall, 99.84% F1-Measure, and 0.002 FPR), which outperforms the other ML classifiers across all evaluation metrics and thus gives high confidence in protecting these networks.

articleTitle: Cyberbullying Detection on Social Media: A Brief Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: this study examines and discusses the findings of several attempts to detect cyberbullying using machine learning and deep learning technology. It gives an overview of existing research that displays different tactics, plans, and procedures for recognizing instances of cyberbullying in material on a range of social networking sites. Social media platforms have made it possible for internet users to communicate their thoughts and emotions, however some users have taken advantage of these networks by indulging in cyberbullying and cyber-harassment where numerous terrible things occur.(delete) Bullying is the first phenomena(phenomenon) developed as a result of the proliferation of social networking platforms. It is described as defining a certain character in order to ridicule or verbally harass others. Previously, the phenomena (phenomenon was) were simply and between individuals, but it has now grown widespread and public, with no regard for values, conventions, or public respect. Because of the prevalence of cyberbullying and its detrimental influence on young people, there has been an increase in studies on its detection in recent years. Automated approaches are developed to detect cyberbullying activity. The study acts as a resource for aspiring researchers as they decide where to focus their research in this field.

articleTitle: Overview on Deep learning aided channel Equalizer Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Data transmission over channels has significant distortions because of the inter-symbol interference that interferes with the dispersive nature of the channel. The performance of wireless network systems depends on channel equalization. In 5G networks, deep learning (DL) has made significant strides toward enhancing communication dependability and reducing computational complexity. Deep learning has shown that it can improve system performance in 5G and future networks while reducing computing complexity. The main topic of this review research is deep learning-aided channel equalization. This study compares several equalization approaches and examines channel equalization methods using classical and deep learning techniques. The comparative research has allowed us to identify the best deep learning models for Channel equalization as well as the previous and present methods used to achieve it. Overall, in various circumstances, the suggested work provides high-speed data transmission across a trustworthy communication channel with the least BER.

articleTitle: Course Timetabling for Distance Learning Program at SKU Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The E-Learning system is very important nowadays for educational institutes as well as for their clients and employees. Especially in the situation like Covid-19 quarantine, because of e-learning features that give cost and time reduction, self-study, instructors can get exams results faster, parents can see their school activities, students no need to go far from their homes,…etc. In addition, anything can be done anytime and anywhere, that's why it is a great technology that must be used by any educational institutions, especially for those subjects that do not require human body language for teaching or on-hand training. Any e-learning system is containing the courses and subjects and those courses need to be put in good scheduling. College course scheduling is an optimization issue with numerous restrictions that must be solved. The most significant aspects of course scheduling should take into account a variety of constraints, such as scheduling conflicts, meeting teacher preferences, maintaining continuity of teaching hours, and so on. To deal with the problem of many limitations, this study used genetic algorithm methods. This study's findings revealed a considerable reduction in the amount of time necessary for course scheduling, and the results were more acceptable to teachers. An adaptive algorithm based on computational intelligence techniques is designed, developed, and applied to the timetabling problem of educational organizations. The proposed genetic algorithm is used to create feasible and efficient timetables for distance education at Sakarya University. In order to demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed genetic algorithm, exhaustive experiments with real-world input data coming from semester 2 of Computer and Information Engineering Department in Sakarya University. Simulation results showed that the proposed algorithm outperforms other existing attempts. However, the most significant contribution of the paper is that the proposed algorithm allows for criteria adaptation, thus producing different timetables for different constraints priorities.

articleTitle: Design of Cloud Computing System for Radio Frequencies Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Cloud computing for Radio Frequency Monitoring (RFM) systems is proposed as a tool for the protection of wireless communication, starting from the control of the Radio Frequency (RF) spectrum usage to the checks of the radio environment in order to scan for illegal radio sources. This paper presents a cloud RFM system which is a huge network of connecting radio communication protection equipment such as direction-finding (DF) systems, and spectrum measurement, based on cloud computing enabling instantaneous monitoring. The proposed system implementation by MATLAB considers various ways such as designing cloud computing, enhancing the performance of DF algorithms, and designing different techniques of the geographic-distributed RFM equipment. The system work starts from the monitoring center that displays all the RFM stations for specific radio emission sources (RES) and shares all harvested data for RFM stations with cloud computing for monitoring and tracking RES. The system test considers the three tracking algorithms for RES which are MUSIC, ROOT-MUSIC, and ROOT-weighted space fitting (WSF), as well as the simulation evaluates the tracking accuracy in the case of minimum number of RFM used and static and moving RES. According to results, the instanton's tracking operation was satisfied by cloud computing, WSF algorithm has proving error distance 10m from real position of RES and two stations with cloud able for tracking static and moving RES.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Smart Healthcare Monitoring System Using Li-Fi Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: In the Intensive care unit (ICU) environments, patients require a continuous healthcare monitoring system to monitor their vital signs. In this paper, a new design and implementation of a smart healthcare system are described using the emerging technologies of Li-Fi and IoT. The heartbeat rate and temperature of the patient are transmitted via Li-Fi technology and then to the central nurse station. This data is uploaded to the ThingSpeak platform cloud so that the doctor can view it anywhere. This system is also provided by sending email notifications in abnormal cases. The results are divided into two parts. The first part is related to the Li-Fi technology. The system is tested for different channel statuses and ambient noise. The second part is the results of the IoT, where the results are presented on the ThinkSpeak platform and notification by Email in critical cases. The system is successfully tested on Imam Al-Sadiq Hospital-Babylon city patients. The obtained results are approved and satisfactory.

articleTitle: Robotic Grasping Based on Deep Learning: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The progress achieved in the robotics field in the last decade made the deployment of robots possible in real - world. One of the essential skills required to do these tasks is object grasping and placing. Grasping is the process of lifting an object without dropping it by the end effector of a robot manipulator. To accomplish the grasping task, a robot has to automatically identify the grip region of a specific item via tactile or visual information. Deep learning, a branch of machine learning developed by simulating human brain activities, can be beneficial in achieving robot grasping tasks. In addition, the development in hardware computational abilities and data availability helped Deep Learning succeed in many fields such as computer vision, image segmentation, and object detection. Derived by this success, many researchers developed Deep Learning-based methods for robot object grasping and achieved promising results. This survey focuses on data-driven (or sometimes called learning-based) approaches based on Deep Learning and used for vision-based robotic grasping. The purpose of this review paper is to provide an overview of object grasping and placing based on Deep Learning, it's used in this field with exploring the most recent works.

articleTitle: Multimedia Privacy Protection Based-on Blockchain: Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: The use of blockchain technology is one of the latest technologies used to protect digital content. This paper provides a brief overview of Blockchain-based applications for protecting the privacy of audiovisual material within the time period (2015–2021), in which methods of using Blockchain technology alone or in combination with traditional content protection techniques (encryption, digital watermarks, fingerprints, etc.) are presented. Recently, researchers moved towards developing this technology by integrating it with different encryption techniques because the number of content protection systems based on Blockchain technology was few due to the many problems in it. For this reason, we note in this review that the number of research in recent years is much greater than in previous years. This paper discussed the technical challenges, advantages, and disadvantages of each method used in previous research, and outlined future research directions.

articleTitle: A Survey on Video Steganography Based on the Techniques and Evaluation Metrics
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advanced Computer Applications (ACA)
abstract: Video steganography is used in a wide range of security applications. The hiding capacity, imperceptibility, and robustness of any steganographic method ultimately determine its effectiveness. many video steganography methods have been presented in the last decade, however there aren't enough survey articles in the literature that cover all of them. This paper provides a review of video steganography through examination and analysis of several approaches and evaluations of their effectiveness. This study also aims to give a qualitative analysis of several video steganography techniques by emphasizing their characteristics. Furthermore, many quality metrics for evaluating various steganography techniques have been presented. Following that, this report offered several future directions that the research community should consider and improve on existing video steganographic techniques. The primary goal of this paper is to assist new researchers in grasping the fundamental principles of this study area in order to begin their research in this topic.
